svg.title: Storage variants with one and eight senders
svg.desc: Simplified BoxedDebounce; points show medians and whiskers show observed min–max across nine interleaved rounds, not confidence intervals. Single-sender medians: Mutex 13.2, adjacent 13.1, padded 13.2, OSAllocated 13.1, separate 17.9 ns. Eight-sender medians: 86.8, 79.7, 54.2, 84.6, 65.7 ns. Separate zero-based scales; eight-sender costs divide aggregate wall time by all sends.
